mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline over 3 months does not yield positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the rank correlation between FEDFUNDS trend and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate above 5.0% does not result in negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the rank IC between UNRATE threshold and 5-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 and rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 215 signals a weakening demand environment coupled with inflationary pressures, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition HOUST<1000 AND CPIAUCSL>215 does not yield negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the rank IC between the interaction condition and 60-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation exceeds 220 (CPIAUCSL > 220) and the federal funds rate is below 2.0% (FEDFUNDS < 2.0), the combination signals a high-risk environment with limited monetary policy flexibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and low policy rate
failure_condition: The condition CPIAUCSL>220 AND FEDFUNDS<2.0 does not yield negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the rank IC between the condition and 20-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) above 380,000 million dollars signals strong demand for housing and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 380,000 does not yield positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the rank IC between RSAFS and 20-day returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 137,000 thousand persons signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS below 137,000 does not result in negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the rank IC between PAYEMS threshold and 5-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 and rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 215 signals a supply shock coupled with inflation, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition INDPRO<110 AND CPIAUCSL>215 does not yield negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the rank IC between the interaction condition and 60-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion phases characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 11700 billion) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 1000), the economy is overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk aversion and profit-taking.
failure_condition: The condition GDPC1>11700 AND HOUST>1000 does not yield negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the rank IC between the condition and 20-day returns is below 0.03.
